cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Count What I Did
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the practical work, time, or inconvenience you contributed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I spent my Saturday fixing your fence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Three panels, eighteen screws, two shops and one blister.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll recommend you to next door. They've got six panels.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them three took my whole Saturday before you make me sound available for Sunday.

mechanism: A copies a craft term literally, then insists that correcting the work must not erase acknowledgment of the time already spent.
confusable: D33 counts actual labor even if flawed; S04 must show the misunderstood model rather than claim unsupported expertise.
comparison: Time lost in technique versus packing volume.
seedUse: D33-b future work recommendation cannot substitute for counting past effort.
